traceability.notes:
The story docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md is fully implemented.
Parser behavior now explicitly supports coexistence with other JSDoc tags: - normalizeCommentLine preserves per-line structure and strips leading '*' while keeping tags. - isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine detects any non-traceability JSDoc tag (e.g., @param, @returns) as a boundary, ignoring @story/@req/@supports themselves. - processCommentLine finalizes the current @story/@req pending annotation when such a boundary is encountered and only treats non-@ lines as continuations, which ensures multi-line values continue to work but do not absorb subsequent JSDoc tags.
Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts explicitly exercise all acceptance criteria: - Traceability before, after, and interleaved with @param/@returns (Before/After/Mixed Positions). - Multi-line @story before other JSDoc tags (Continuation & Preserve Multiline). - A regression test replicating the original bug ensures that JSDoc tags do not get concatenated into the requirement ID (No False Positives, Proper Termination, Boundary Detection).
Documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md has been updated with a dedicated "JSDoc coexistence" section and examples showing valid annotation positions relative to other JSDoc tags.
The entire test suite passes, indicating backward compatibility with existing valid annotations. Together, the implementation, tests, and documentation satisfy all acceptance criteria and requirements for this story.
